subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The west Africans have a heritage of produsing sculpture using wax and bronze.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Produsing"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Producing".**
 
• **Producing** means creating or bringing forth something, especially through a process of manufacture or construction. (उत्पादन करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The factory is **producing** thousands of units every day.
 
 
 
• **Produsing** does not have a meaning in English as it is a misspelled word.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bronze** (कांस्य): A yellowish-brown alloy of copper with up to one-third tin.

 
 
• **Example:** The statue was made of **bronze** and looked magnificent.
 
 
 
• **Heritage** (विरासत): Property that is or may be inherited; an inheritance.
 
 
• **Example:** The cultural **heritage** of the country includes music, dance, and traditional crafts.
 
 
 
• **Sculpture** (मूर्तिकला): The art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.
 
 
• **Example:** The museum has a beautiful **sculpture** of a famous historical figure.
